question:
**Complete the sentence by choosing the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

If the answer is __false__, it is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**untrue**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word '**false**' is '**untrue**'.
 
• **False**: not true; not correct. (असत्‍य, ग़लत)
 
 
• *Example: I think the information you have been given is **false**.*
 
 
 
• **Untrue**: not true; not based on facts. (असत्‍य, झूठा; जो तथ्‍यों पर आधारित नहीं, निराधार, बेबुनियाद)
 
 
• *Example: These accusations are totally **untrue**.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Untrue.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **genuine**: real; true. (वास्‍तविक; असली)
 
• **correct**: with no mistakes; right or true. (शुद्घ, त्रुटिहीन; सही या सत्‍य)
 
• **right**: correct; true. (शुद्घ, सही; सच)

The correct answer is **'to meeting'.**
